      • resolveFileInRootDir

        protected File resolveFileInRootDir(String pathname)
        Resolves the given guest pathname against rootDir and returns the resulting host File only when it is strictly contained within rootDir. Path traversal components (e.g. ../) are neutralised by canonicalization before the containment check is performed.
        Parameters:
        pathname - guest-controlled path component
        Returns:
        the resolved host File, or null when the resolved path would escape rootDir (traversal attempt)
